topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I stopped dead in the hallway, the school’s familiar beep of the bell echoing as I did. There she was, my old teacher, Mrs. Thompson, standing in the doorway of Room 204, her hair a bit grayer but her smile just as warm. I remember that smile, the way she used to hold the class in the palm of her hand, making even the dullest topics come alive. Now, here she was, welcoming my child into the same classroom where I once sat, wide-eyed and hopeful. It’s a small world, I thought, but not quite small enough for this. My heart picked up its pace, and I wondered what stories my child would bring home, perhaps the same ones I once did.
